& - ( ) kya Corn se Dhokla ban sakta hai? Ji bilkul, and super soft bhi. This is a perfect lunchbox/ tiffin recipe that needs little prep and will be an instant hit with your kids! Not just dhokla, there's a bonus uthappam recipe too!
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 20-25 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Semolina Mixture
2 no. Green Chillies (chopped), hari mirch
¼ cup fresh Coriander leaves (finely chopped), dhaniya patta
